# All-in-one text formatter

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/text-formatter/

Format text in one place: uppercase, lowercase, title case, sentence case, whitespace cleanup and live word counts. Undo a change, copy the output or download a text file.

## How to use it

1. Paste your text and check the live counts.
2. Choose a formatting action or undo a change.
3. Copy the formatted result or download a TXT file.

## Example

Paste a paragraph with extra spaces, choose Clean spacing, then check the word count and copy the tidy result.

## Limits and checks

Remove all whitespace also removes line breaks. Case conversion follows your browser’s Unicode rules; proofread names and language-specific capitalization.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
